newsitem.title: UK: Crest Nicholson up on improved profits.
newsitem.headline: Crest Nicholson up on improved profits.

text.p: Shares in Crest Nicholson Plc rose on Thursday after the housebuilder posted a 61 percent increase in annual pre-tax profits coupled with an upbeat assessment of prospects for the coming year.
The stock was 5-1/2p higher at 94p by 0853 GMT.
Pre-tax profits rose to 10.0 millon stg in the year ended October 31 from 6.2 million the previous year, on turnover six percent higher at 332.3 million stg.

"I am optimistic of the outcome for the current financial year and believe Crest now has a structure and strategy that should increasingly reward shareholders over the longer term," said chairman John Matthews.
"The strategic, operational and management steps that we have taken over the last year provide a strong base from which to take full advantage of any improvement in trading conditions."
The full-year dividend was raised 25 percent to 2.5p per share.
